meta.name: acculynx-automation
meta.description: Automate Acculynx tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动执行Acculynx中的重复任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在Acculynx中手动操作重复性任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate repetitive tasks in Acculynx with MCP integration.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently perform manual repetitive tasks in Acculynx.

howto.what: Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动发现并执行 Acculynx 中的操作任务，如创建客户、管理工单等，无需手动登录系统。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在 Acculynx 中执行操作（如创建客户、更新工单）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新客户，名字叫张三，电话13812345678。
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并执行创建客户操作。

say.text: 查询客户李四的联系方式。
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并查询。

say.text: 更新工单 #123 的状态为已完成。
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并更新工单。

howto.what_en: Claude can automatically discover and execute Acculynx tasks via Rube MCP, such as creating customers, managing work orders, without manual login.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform operations in Acculynx, such as creating a customer, updating a work order.

say_en.text: Create a new customer named John with phone 1234567890.
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and execute creation.

say_en.text: Find contact info for customer Jane.
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and query.

say_en.text: Update work order #123 status to completed.
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and update.
